mapper.insert: INSERT INTO zw_teacher (TEACHER_ID, USER_ID, SEX, TEACHER_CODE, TEACH_SUBJECT, TEACHER_STATUS, TEACHER_TYPE, PHONE, GRA, CLA) VALUES (#{teacherId}, #{userId}, #{sex}, #{teacherCode}, #{teachSubject}, #{teacherStatus}, #{teacherType}, #{phone}, #{gra}, #{cla})
mapper.select: SELECT t.*, u.USER_NAME, u.NAME, sex.CODE_DESC as SEX_DESC, ts.CODE_DESC as TEACHER_STATUS_DESC, tt.CODE_DESC as TEACHER_TYPE_DESC, sub.CODE_DESC as TEACH_SUBJECT_DESC FROM zw_teacher t LEFT JOIN g_user u ON t.USER_ID = u.USER_ID LEFT JOIN g_code sex ON t.SEX = sex.CODE_ID LEFT JOIN g_code ts ON t.TEACHER_STATUS = ts.CODE_ID LEFT JOIN g_code tt ON t.TEACHER_TYPE = tt.CODE_ID LEFT JOIN g_code sub ON t.TEACH_SUBJECT = sub.CODE_ID WHERE t.TEACHER_ID = #{teacherId}

SELECT t.*, u.USER_NAME, u.NAME, sex.CODE_DESC as SEX_DESC, ts.CODE_DESC as TEACHER_STATUS_DESC, tt.CODE_DESC as TEACHER_TYPE_DESC, sub.CODE_DESC as TEACH_SUBJECT_DESC FROM zw_teacher t LEFT JOIN g_user u ON t.USER_ID = u.USER_ID LEFT JOIN g_code sex ON t.SEX = sex.CODE_ID LEFT JOIN g_code ts ON t.TEACHER_STATUS = ts.CODE_ID LEFT JOIN g_code tt ON t.TEACHER_TYPE = tt.CODE_ID LEFT JOIN g_code sub ON t.TEACH_SUBJECT = sub.CODE_ID ORDER BY u.USER_NAME
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO g_user (USER_ID, USER_NAME, PASSWORD, NAME, USER_STATUS, ROLE, LOGIN_FAIL_COUNT, LOCK_TIME) VALUES (#{userId}, #{userName}, #{password}, #{name}, 10001001, 14981002, 0, null)
